sql:
SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN gross_cents - paid_cents ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN gross_cents ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS discount_rate
FROM "data"."main"."order_fact" order_model_src_10000
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31'
answer: 青禾在2026年5月、全部门店汇总的优惠率为 0.09886615345916308（小数比例），约为 0.0989。口径为：优惠金额除以支付订单原价金额；分母为零时该比例未定义。
